name: Mattermost
tagline: Open source team chat for technical teams. Self-hosted Slack/Teams replacement.
shortDescription: Mattermost is the chat platform used by the US Department of Defense, NASA, and 800+ enterprises. It focuses on technical workflows: deep GitHub/GitLab/Jira integration, runbooks, and high-trust compliance features. Self-hostable in Docker.
longDescription:
## What it is

Mattermost is a team chat platform built for technical and security-sensitive organizations. It has all the standard chat features (channels, threads, DMs, voice, video) plus deep integrations with developer tools and compliance features for regulated industries.

## Why we recommend it

It is the most-loved open source chat in the DevOps / SRE community. The GitHub integration, slash commands, and Playbook automation make it feel like Slack built by engineers, for engineers. The self-hosted Community Edition is free and MIT-licensed; the paid tiers add compliance features (SAML, audit logs, data retention policies) at per-user pricing that's 80% cheaper than Slack.

## When to use it

- Engineering teams that want Slack with better DevOps integration
- Companies in regulated industries (defense, finance, healthcare)
- Organizations that need to comply with data residency rules (self-host in EU/US/APAC)
- Teams that need chat + runbooks + incident response in one platform
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
1. `docker run -d --name mattermost -p 8065:8065 mattermost/mattermost-team-edition`
2. Open `http://localhost:8065` and create your first team
3. Invite users via email or share the link

**Kubernetes:** Use the official operator.

**Cloud (managed):** Free for 90 days, then $10/user/mo Cloud Professional, $15/user/mo Cloud Enterprise.
pricingDetails: Team Edition: free, self-hosted, MIT. Cloud Professional: $10/user/mo. Cloud Enterprise: $15/user/mo. Self-hosted Enterprise: custom (perpetual license).
